Dear Benjamin,
Hope you are doing well.
As per the reported issue, we have analyzed the logs and found that the session was aborted because the EV stopped the charging process. However, the exact reason for this is not captured in the logs.
For your reference, please check the logs, where you can see that the session was aborted due to the EV sent a stop command.
